verdicts.reason: A is just the original block shrunk and centred. It takes up about a third of the banner and leaves huge dead areas on both sides, so it is not a rearrangement for the wide format, and the fine print is tiny. B does rearrange the design left to right: phone, then a one-line headline, then the CTA. But the phone is jammed almost against the top and bottom edges, the CTA sits isolated far to the right across a large empty gap, the CTA is undersized, and the '7 days free' line is illegibly small.
